name: Gilded Guide
descriptionTemplate: At turn start, gain [Arg2] Shield. At turn end, deal DMG to a random enemy equal to [Arg1]% of your current Shield. In Boss Battle, the DMG is doubled.
lore: When you're lost, open it. But be cautious—its corona must not be exposed to sunlight.
